title: report table: a dataset dimension nullLabel is not drawn — the null bucket reads "—" although the dataset query answer carries the label
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, a QA run clause fail (studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix acceptance[1], the dataset row's report leg).
Business reason: #25391 gave `DatasetDimension` a `nullLabel` so a null bucket reads as words ("No region") instead of a dash. The dashboard widget draws it; the report table does not, so the same dataset reads "No region" on a dashboard and "—" in a report, and a report reader cannot tell an empty value from a missing one.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:ui` implementer in `ui/packages/plugin-report/`. QA suggestion only: `area:reports`, p3.
Duplicate search: `nullLabel` → 10 hits; #25391 (closed) is the spec change, #25330 (closed) a Setup chart; none is the report renderer. `nullLabel DatasetReportRenderer` → 2 hits, `formatDimensionValue` → 1 hit (#5666, a pivot placeholder), none about this.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. On a writable package, publish dataset `qar8_dataset` over `qar8_dsobj` with dimension `{name:'region', field:'region', type:'string', nullLabel:'No region (R8)'}` and a count measure, and report `qar8_report` `{type:'summary', dataset:'qar8_dataset', rows:['region'], values:[…]}`. Seed one row with `region` null.
2. Open `/_console/apps/APP/report/qar8_report`.

Expected: the null row reads "No region (R8)". Actual: "— | 1 | €30.00 | 30 | 1 | 100.0%". The page's own `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` answer carries `fields.region.nullLabel` "No region (R8)" and the row `{region:null,…}`. Measures, currency and ratio render correctly. Reproduced 3 times.

## Mechanism (suspected)
`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` table cells (about L1025, L1079, L2044) call `formatDimensionValue()` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/dataset-format.ts` about L516 returns "—" for null) and never read `fields[].nullLabel`. `plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` (about L535–554) does. The spec (`packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts` about L176) says "A renderer draws the column's null values under it instead of its own default".

QA-source: #29002 · studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix · acceptance[1]
